first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: A short-barreled handgun that remains in the lower-right foreground, with a dark-colored body, cyan-green highlights, and a block-shaped slide.

entities.name: riveted metal wall panel
entities.identification: Large light-gray to blue-gray indoor wall panels, with dark, circular rivets arranged near the seams.

entities.name: metal floor
entities.identification: A gray-brown metal panel floor in the upper-level passage, with straight seams and regularly repeating embossed patterns.

entities.name: dark-colored metal ceiling
entities.identification: A dark-colored, sectioned ceiling surface above the passage, with parallel layered trim at the wall-ceiling junction.

entities.name: metal ladder
entities.identification: A partially exposed ladder-like structure below the hatch, with multiple parallel rungs visible; the complete side rails and mounting connections are not clearly revealed.

entities.name: hatch guardrail
entities.identification: Dark-colored bent rods and horizontal rod sections on both sides of the hatch, with straight edges.

entities.name: gray fragments
entities.identification: Gray irregular panel-like pieces and sharp-cornered pieces scattered in overlapping arrangements near the base of the wall at the rear of the passage.

entities.name: yellow stain
entities.identification: Light-yellow irregular patches and scattered small spots adhering to the floor and the base of the wall.

entities.name: indoor light fixture
entities.identification: Two lights on the ceiling, one near and one far; the near light emits cyan-white light, and the far light emits warm-white light.

entities.name: hatch flange
entities.identification: A thick metal edge extending horizontally along the near side of the hatch, dark gray with a cyan-green illuminated surface.
